text: Now, we are this morning. We are starting with the Mac. Okay, what the Mac layer functions do. As a general thing, as we said, the Mac layer functions will be there to understand when the node can access the channel. That means the packet can be sent, as we said, to the physical layer, and then actually transmit. Now, it is useful to model the Mac layer in this way. So the Mac layer can be abstracted, seen as made of a queue and a server. Have you ever seen this kind of model, a queue model? No, it is often used to model many different systems. Originally, the researcher who many years ago proposed this kind of model used this model to represent people who are in line at a supermarket cashier.
